paragraphs: From the Carlow Talbot Hotel set off along the R924.
After about 500 metres turn left to stay on the R924.
At the roundabout take it slight left onto the N80.
Continue on the N80 for roughly 400 metres and join the main N80 stretch.
Stay on the N80 for another 500 metres.
At the next roundabout go left to remain on the N80.
At the Sleaty Road Roundabout exit left.
At the next roundabout exit left onto Cannery Road.
Follow Cannery Road until you reach Dr Cullen Road.
Continue along Dr Cullen Road for about 340 metres.
At the roundabout take the left exit onto the Dublin Road.
At the next roundabout go straight ahead onto O'Brien Road.
At the following roundabout exit slight left to remain on O'Brien Road.
After around 500 metres turn left onto Browneshill Road.
Turn left into Browneshill Wood and follow it round to the right.
Take the 1st right into Browneshill Rise.
When the examiner asks, carry out a turnabout (U-turn) on Browneshill Rise.
Retrace your route with a left back onto Browneshill Wood.
Then turn right onto Browneshill Road.
Head back along Browneshill Road for about 600 metres.
At the end of the road turn left onto O'Brien Road.
Go straight through the next roundabout, staying on O'Brien Road.
At the roundabout take it slight left onto Carpenter Way.
Continue straight through the following roundabout, still on Carpenter Way.
At the Paupish Bridge roundabout go straight ahead.
At the Hanover Roundabout go slight right and turn right onto the Kilkenny Road.
At the next roundabout take it left, then slight left onto Kennedy Avenue.
Continue straight through the roundabout on Kennedy Avenue, which becomes Kennedy Street.
Turn right onto Chapel Street to complete the loop back toward the Carlow Talbot Hotel test centre.
